children: investment blueprint covers energy & aviation: MD Our Bureau Mumbai: The Adani Group is committed to investing more than 6 lakh crore in Maharashtra across energy, aviation, urban regeneration, data centres and coal gasification, its managing director (agro, oil & gas) Pranav Adani said at the launch of 'Invest Maharashtra' on Friday.

The investments come as Maharashtra aims to become a $1 trillion economy by 2030, with the Mumbai Metropolitan Region expected to play a central role. Invest Maharashtra is an integrated single-window platform launched by the state government to streamline industrial development. "At the World Economic Forum in Davos and through state partnerships, the Adani Group has committed to an investment blueprint exceeding 6 lakh crore across critical and upcoming sectors," Adani said. "Projects worth 2.6 lakh crore are already completed or under execution." In aviation, he highlighted the management and expansion of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport and the development of the greenfield Navi Mumbai International Airport, which is designed to eventually handle more than 90 million passengers annually.

The group is also developing integrated airport business and hospitality districts around both airports. In the power sector, Adani Electricity Mumbai supplies more than 3 million homes and establishments in Mumbai, with more than 60% of its power supply sourced from renewable energy, according to Adani.

The company also operates a 1,000 MW high-voltage direct-current transmission link that brings power into Mumbai. The group is pursuing pumped-storage hydro projects across Maharashtra to support round-the-clock green power. Adani also highlighted the Dharavi Redevelopment Project, describing it as a people-first urban transformation initiative involving modern housing, formalisation of micro-enterprises and redevelopment of the settlement into an integrated economic hub. Adani said Maharashtra had emerged as a major economic hub because of its governance, connectivity, execution capability and human capital. He reaffirmed the group's commitment to work with the state government on industrial and infrastructure development.

title: 'Adani Group Committed to its over 6L cr Maha Investment'
